items.printedDescription: A very rich and spicy mutton curry with thick consistency.

items.name: RN- SPECIAL MUTTON ( 4 PCS )
items.printedDescription: It's Hotel Rajnandini Indian main course chef special dish. a delicious curry which is made in yogurt cashew and poppy seeds paste that given it a rich flavour.

items.name: VETKI MASALA CURRY(4PCS)
items.printedDescription: a dish where tender Bhetki fish is slow-cooked in a bold & aromatic masala gravy.

items.name: KATLA KALIA (2PCS)
items.printedDescription: A dish steeped in tradition, Katla Kalia is a rich and flavorful Bengali delicacy where succulent Katla fish is slow-cooked in a thick, aromatic gravy.

items.name: KATLA FRY (2PCS)
items.printedDescription: Katla fish is marinated with aromatic spices and shallow-fried to crispy perfection. Every bite is a perfect blend of crunch and succulence!

items.name: PRAWN MALAI CURRY (3PCS)
items.printedDescription: Prawn Malai Curry is a creamy, coconut-infused masterpiece where succulent prawns are slow-cooked in a rich, aromatic gravy.

items.name: DAAB CHINGRI (3PCS)
items.printedDescription: this dish is an explosion of flavors, blending the richness of seafood with the creaminess of coconut.
